items.question: Trong câu "a BA without IT thinking will write down exactly that sentence and hand it to the dev.", từ "write down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a BA without IT thinking will write down exactly that sentence and hand it to the dev.", what does "write down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: write down /ˌraɪt ˈdaʊn/ (cụm từ): ghi lại, chép lại. "Write down a requirement" = ghi lại yêu cầu; "write-down" (danh từ kế toán) = ghi giảm giá trị.
items.explanationEn: write down /ˌraɪt ˈdaʊn/ (phrase): to record on paper. "Write down a requirement" means note it; the accounting noun "write-down" means reducing value.

items.question: Trong câu "a BA without IT thinking will write down exactly that sentence and hand it to the dev.", từ "hand" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a BA without IT thinking will write down exactly that sentence and hand it to the dev.", what does "hand" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hand /hænd/ (động từ): đưa, trao cho. "Hand something to someone" = đưa cái gì cho ai; "hand over" = bàn giao.
items.explanationEn: hand /hænd/ (verb): to pass to someone. "Hand something to someone" means pass it; "hand over" means transfer responsibility.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA with IT thinking, on the other hand, will immediately picture in their head:", từ "on the other hand" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA with IT thinking, on the other hand, will immediately picture in their head:", what does "on the other hand" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on the other hand /ɒn ði ˈʌðə hænd/ (cụm từ): mặt khác, ngược lại. "On the other hand" dùng để đưa ra ý đối lập với ý trước.
items.explanationEn: on the other hand /ɒn ði ˈʌðə hænd/ (phrase): in contrast. "On the other hand" introduces a contrasting point.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA with IT thinking, on the other hand, will immediately picture in their head:", từ "immediately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA with IT thinking, on the other hand, will immediately picture in their head:", what does "immediately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: immediately /ɪˈmiːdiətli/ (trạng từ): ngay lập tức. "Immediately picture" = hình dung ngay; tính từ: immediate.
items.explanationEn: immediately /ɪˈmiːdiətli/ (adverb): at once. "Immediately picture" means imagine at once; adjective: immediate.

items.question: Trong câu "Data: what does an order contain? customer, product, quantity, price, status", từ "contain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data: what does an order contain? customer, product, quantity, price, status", what does "contain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contain /kənˈteɪn/ (động từ): chứa, bao gồm. "What does an order contain?" = đơn hàng gồm những gì; danh từ: container.
items.explanationEn: contain /kənˈteɪn/ (verb): to have inside. "What does an order contain?" asks what is inside it; noun: container.

items.question: Trong câu "Data: what does an order contain? customer, product, quantity, price, status", từ "quantity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data: what does an order contain? customer, product, quantity, price, status", what does "quantity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: quantity /ˈkwɒntəti/ (danh từ): số lượng. "Quantity" = số lượng; đừng nhầm với quality (chất lượng).
items.explanationEn: quantity /ˈkwɒntəti/ (noun): an amount or number. "Quantity" is how many; do not confuse it with quality.

items.question: Trong câu "Questions: who creates the order? who approves it? how does the status change?", từ "approve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Questions: who creates the order? who approves it? how does the status change?", what does "approve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: approve /əˈpruːv/ (động từ): phê duyệt. "Approve an order" = duyệt đơn; danh từ: approval (sự phê duyệt).
items.explanationEn: approve /əˈpruːv/ (verb): to officially accept. "Approve an order" means officially accept it; noun: approval.

items.question: Trong câu "Whenever you hear any requirement, analyze it along 3 dimensions:", từ "whenever" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Whenever you hear any requirement, analyze it along 3 dimensions:", what does "whenever" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: whenever /wenˈevə/ (liên từ): bất cứ khi nào. "Whenever you hear..." = mỗi khi bạn nghe...; tương tự: every time.
items.explanationEn: whenever /wenˈevə/ (conjunction): at any time that. "Whenever you hear..." means every time you hear.

items.question: Trong câu "Whenever you hear any requirement, analyze it along 3 dimensions:", từ "analyze" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Whenever you hear any requirement, analyze it along 3 dimensions:", what does "analyze" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: analyze /ˈænəlaɪz/ (động từ): phân tích. Anh-Anh viết analyse; danh từ: analysis, người: analyst (BA = business analyst).
items.explanationEn: analyze /ˈænəlaɪz/ (verb): to examine in detail. British spelling: analyse; noun: analysis; person: analyst.

items.question: Trong câu "Whenever you hear any requirement, analyze it along 3 dimensions:", từ "dimension" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Whenever you hear any requirement, analyze it along 3 dimensions:", what does "dimension" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dimension /daɪˈmenʃn/ (danh từ): khía cạnh, chiều. "Along 3 dimensions" = theo 3 khía cạnh; "dimensions" cũng là kích thước.
items.explanationEn: dimension /daɪˈmenʃn/ (noun): an aspect of a situation. "Along 3 dimensions" means from 3 aspects; "dimensions" can also be measurements.

items.question: Trong câu "Every important noun in a requirement is an entity in the database.", từ "entity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every important noun in a requirement is an entity in the database.", what does "entity" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a thing the system stores data about
items.explanation: entity /ˈentəti/ (danh từ): thực thể (đối tượng dữ liệu). "Entity" trong database = đối tượng cần lưu như Customer, Order.
items.explanationEn: entity /ˈentəti/ (noun): a thing the system stores data about. In a database an "entity" is a thing to store, such as Customer or Order.

items.question: Trong câu "Every verb in a requirement is an action the system performs.", từ "perform" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every verb in a requirement is an action the system performs.", what does "perform" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to act or sing on stage
items.explanation: perform /pəˈfɔːm/ (động từ): thực hiện. "Perform an action" = thực hiện hành động; danh từ: performance (hiệu năng, màn biểu diễn).
items.explanationEn: perform /pəˈfɔːm/ (verb): to carry out. "Perform an action" means carry it out; noun: performance.

items.question: Trong câu "Every important entity has a lifecycle with a set of states:", từ "lifecycle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every important entity has a lifecycle with a set of states:", what does "lifecycle" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the stages from start to end
items.explanation: lifecycle /ˈlaɪfsaɪkl/ (danh từ): vòng đời. "Order lifecycle" = vòng đời đơn hàng: mới tạo → xác nhận → hoàn thành.
items.explanationEn: lifecycle /ˈlaɪfsaɪkl/ (noun): the stages from start to end. An "order lifecycle" runs from created to confirmed to completed.

items.question: Trong câu "When you hear a requirement, try underlining every noun and every verb.", từ "underline" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you hear a requirement, try underlining every noun and every verb.", what does "underline" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: underline /ˌʌndəˈlaɪn/ (động từ): gạch chân. "Underline a word" = gạch chân từ; nghĩa bóng: nhấn mạnh.
items.explanationEn: underline /ˌʌndəˈlaɪn/ (verb): to draw a line under. "Underline a word" means draw a line under it; figuratively, to emphasize.

items.question: Trong câu "View what? → this is the data that needs to be displayed", từ "display" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "View what? → this is the data that needs to be displayed", what does "display" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: display /dɪˈspleɪ/ (động từ): hiển thị. "Be displayed" = được hiển thị; danh từ: display (màn hình).
items.explanationEn: display /dɪˈspleɪ/ (verb): to show on screen. "Be displayed" means shown on screen; noun: display.

items.question: Trong câu "Go where? → this is the navigation", từ "navigation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Go where? → this is the navigation", what does "navigation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: navigation /ˌnævɪˈɡeɪʃn/ (danh từ): điều hướng giữa màn hình. "Navigation bar" = thanh điều hướng; động từ: navigate.
items.explanationEn: navigation /ˌnævɪˈɡeɪʃn/ (noun): moving between screens. A "navigation bar" helps users move around; verb: navigate.

items.question: Trong câu "Just draw boxes and arrows:", từ "arrow" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Just draw boxes and arrows:", what does "arrow" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: arrow /ˈærəʊ/ (danh từ): mũi tên. "Boxes and arrows" = hộp và mũi tên, cách vẽ sơ đồ luồng đơn giản.
items.explanationEn: arrow /ˈærəʊ/ (noun): a pointed line showing direction. "Boxes and arrows" are the simplest way to sketch a flow.

items.question: Trong câu "Spot missing screens", từ "spot" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Spot missing screens", what does "spot" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: spot /spɒt/ (động từ): phát hiện, nhận ra. "Spot a mistake" = phát hiện lỗi; danh từ spot = vết, chỗ.
items.explanationEn: spot /spɒt/ (verb): to notice. "Spot a mistake" means notice it; the noun spot means a mark or place.

items.question: Trong câu "Spot missing screens", từ "missing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Spot missing screens", what does "missing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: missing /ˈmɪsɪŋ/ (tính từ): bị thiếu. "Missing screens" = màn hình bị thiếu; "missing data" = dữ liệu bị thiếu.
items.explanationEn: missing /ˈmɪsɪŋ/ (adjective): not there, absent. "Missing screens" are screens nobody planned; "missing data" is absent data.

items.question: Trong câu "Identify the entry point and exit point", từ "entry point" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Identify the entry point and exit point", what does "entry point" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: where a user first comes in
items.explanation: entry point /ˈentri pɔɪnt/ (cụm từ): điểm bắt đầu vào. "Entry point" = nơi người dùng bắt đầu; "exit point" = nơi rời khỏi luồng.
items.explanationEn: entry point /ˈentri pɔɪnt/ (phrase): where a user first comes in. The "entry point" is where a flow starts; the "exit point" is where it ends.

items.question: Trong câu "Know which screens need authentication", từ "authentication" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Know which screens need authentication", what does "authentication" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: deciding what a user may do
items.explanation: authentication /ɔːˌθentɪˈkeɪʃn/ (danh từ): xác thực danh tính. "Authentication" = xác thực bạn là ai; khác authorization = bạn được làm gì.
items.explanationEn: authentication /ɔːˌθentɪˈkeɪʃn/ (noun): proving who a user is. "Authentication" checks who you are; authorization checks what you may do.

items.question: Trong câu "Rule 2: What fields does each table need?", từ "field" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rule 2: What fields does each table need?", what does "field" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a single piece of data in a record
items.explanation: field /fiːld/ (danh từ): trường dữ liệu. "Required field" = trường bắt buộc; "field" còn là lĩnh vực (the IT field).
items.explanationEn: field /fiːld/ (noun): a single piece of data in a record. A "required field" must be filled; "field" can also mean an area of work.

items.question: Trong câu "3 common relationship types:", từ "relationship" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "3 common relationship types:", what does "relationship" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: relationship /rɪˈleɪʃnʃɪp/ (danh từ): mối quan hệ (giữa bảng). "One-to-many relationship" = quan hệ một-nhiều giữa hai bảng.
items.explanationEn: relationship /rɪˈleɪʃnʃɪp/ (noun): a link between tables. A "one-to-many relationship" links one row to many rows in another table.

items.question: Trong câu "N-N (Many - Many): needs a junction table", từ "junction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "N-N (Many - Many): needs a junction table", what does "junction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: junction /ˈdʒʌŋkʃn/ (danh từ): chỗ nối, trung gian. "Junction table" = bảng trung gian nối hai bảng quan hệ nhiều-nhiều.
items.explanationEn: junction /ˈdʒʌŋkʃn/ (noun): a connecting point. A "junction table" connects two tables in a many-to-many relationship.

items.question: Trong câu "For each state transition, ask:", từ "transition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For each state transition, ask:", what does "transition" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a change from one state to another
items.explanation: transition /trænˈzɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự chuyển đổi trạng thái. "State transition" = chuyển trạng thái, ví dụ pending → confirmed.
items.explanationEn: transition /trænˈzɪʃn/ (noun): a change from one state to another. A "state transition" is a move such as pending → confirmed.

items.question: Trong câu "Who has the right to trigger it?", từ "trigger" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Who has the right to trigger it?", what does "trigger" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trigger /ˈtrɪɡə/ (động từ): kích hoạt. "Trigger an event" = kích hoạt sự kiện; danh từ trigger = tác nhân kích hoạt.
items.explanationEn: trigger /ˈtrɪɡə/ (verb): to cause to start. "Trigger an event" means make it start; as a noun it is the thing that starts it.

items.question: Trong câu "Instead of asking vague questions, apply 5W1H to fully draw out a requirement:", từ "draw out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Instead of asking vague questions, apply 5W1H to fully draw out a requirement:", what does "draw out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: draw out /ˌdrɔː ˈaʊt/ (cụm từ): khai thác, làm rõ. "Draw out a requirement" = khai thác đầy đủ yêu cầu bằng câu hỏi.
items.explanationEn: draw out /ˌdrɔː ˈaʊt/ (phrase): to get information from. "Draw out a requirement" means getting all its details by asking.

items.question: Trong câu "Instead of asking vague questions, apply 5W1H to fully draw out a requirement:", từ "apply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Instead of asking vague questions, apply 5W1H to fully draw out a requirement:", what does "apply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: apply /əˈplaɪ/ (động từ): áp dụng. "Apply a method" = áp dụng phương pháp; "apply for" = nộp đơn xin.
items.explanationEn: apply /əˈplaɪ/ (verb): to put into use. "Apply a method" means use it; "apply for" means formally request.

items.question: Trong câu "Who uses this feature? (user role)", từ "role" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Who uses this feature? (user role)", what does "role" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: role /rəʊl/ (danh từ): vai trò. "User role" = vai trò người dùng (admin, member); "play a role" = đóng vai trò.
items.explanationEn: role /rəʊl/ (noun): a function or position. A "user role" is admin or member; "play a role" means take part.

items.question: Trong câu "Who has permission to view / edit / delete?", từ "permission" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Who has permission to view / edit / delete?", what does "permission" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: permission /pəˈmɪʃn/ (danh từ): quyền hạn. "Have permission to" = có quyền làm gì; động từ: permit.
items.explanationEn: permission /pəˈmɪʃn/ (noun): the right to do something. "Have permission to" means be allowed to; verb: permit.

items.question: Trong câu "Who gets notified when an event occurs?", từ "notify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Who gets notified when an event occurs?", what does "notify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: notify /ˈnəʊtɪfaɪ/ (động từ): thông báo cho. "Get notified" = nhận thông báo; danh từ: notification.
items.explanationEn: notify /ˈnəʊtɪfaɪ/ (verb): to inform. "Get notified" means receive an alert; noun: notification.

items.question: Trong câu "Who gets notified when an event occurs?", từ "occur" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Who gets notified when an event occurs?", what does "occur" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: occur /əˈkɜː/ (động từ): xảy ra. "An event occurs" = một sự kiện xảy ra; danh từ: occurrence.
items.explanationEn: occur /əˈkɜː/ (verb): to happen. "An event occurs" means it happens; noun: occurrence.

items.question: Trong câu "What is the trigger (manual / automatic / scheduled)?", từ "manual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What is the trigger (manual / automatic / scheduled)?", what does "manual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: manual /ˈmænjuəl/ (tính từ): thủ công, bằng tay. "Manual trigger" = kích hoạt thủ công; danh từ manual = sách hướng dẫn.
items.explanationEn: manual /ˈmænjuəl/ (adjective): done by a person. A "manual trigger" is started by a person; the noun manual is a guide book.

items.question: Trong câu "After how long does the data expire?", từ "expire" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After how long does the data expire?", what does "expire" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expire /ɪkˈspaɪə/ (động từ): hết hạn. "The token expires" = token hết hạn; danh từ: expiry/expiration.
items.explanationEn: expire /ɪkˈspaɪə/ (verb): to stop being valid. "The token expires" means it is no longer valid; noun: expiry.

items.question: Trong câu "Is this a must-have or a nice-to-have?", từ "must-have" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is this a must-have or a nice-to-have?", what does "must-have" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: must-have /ˈmʌst hæv/ (danh từ): thứ bắt buộc phải có. "Must-have" = bắt buộc; "nice-to-have" = có thì tốt; dùng khi ưu tiên tính năng.
items.explanationEn: must-have /ˈmʌst hæv/ (noun): something essential. "Must-have" is essential; "nice-to-have" is optional; both help prioritize.

items.question: Trong câu "How does the system handle errors?", từ "handle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How does the system handle errors?", what does "handle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: handle /ˈhændl/ (động từ): xử lý. "Handle errors" = xử lý lỗi; danh từ handle = tay cầm.
items.explanationEn: handle /ˈhændl/ (verb): to deal with. "Handle errors" means deal with them; the noun handle is a grip.

items.question: Trong câu "What performance level does it need to reach?", từ "performance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What performance level does it need to reach?", what does "performance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: performance /pəˈfɔːməns/ (danh từ): hiệu năng (tốc độ). "Performance" trong IT = hiệu năng (tốc độ, tải); nghĩa khác: buổi biểu diễn.
items.explanationEn: performance /pəˈfɔːməns/ (noun): how fast a system works. In IT "performance" means speed and capacity; it can also be a stage show.

items.question: Trong câu "Common thinking traps and how to avoid them", từ "trap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Common thinking traps and how to avoid them", what does "trap" (noun) mean?
options: cái bẫy, sai lầm dễ mắc
optionsEn: a mistake that is easy to make
items.explanation: trap /træp/ (danh từ): cái bẫy, sai lầm dễ mắc. "Thinking trap" = bẫy tư duy; "fall into a trap" = mắc bẫy.
items.explanationEn: trap /træp/ (noun): a mistake that is easy to make. A "thinking trap" is a common mental mistake; "fall into a trap" means make it.

items.question: Trong câu "Common thinking traps and how to avoid them", từ "avoid" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Common thinking traps and how to avoid them", what does "avoid" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: avoid /əˈvɔɪd/ (động từ): tránh. "Avoid doing something" = tránh làm gì (theo sau là V-ing).
items.explanationEn: avoid /əˈvɔɪd/ (verb): to keep away from. "Avoid doing something" is followed by the -ing form.

items.question: Trong câu "Step 5 — Questions to ask the stakeholder:", từ "stakeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Step 5 — Questions to ask the stakeholder:", what does "stakeholder" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person with an interest in the project
items.explanation: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkhəʊldə/ (danh từ): bên liên quan. "Stakeholder" = bên liên quan (khách hàng, quản lý, người dùng...).
items.explanationEn: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkhəʊldə/ (noun): a person with an interest in the project. A "stakeholder" is anyone affected by the project, such as clients or managers.

items.question: Trong câu "Trap 1: Thinking in terms of UI first, forgetting the data", từ "in terms of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trap 1: Thinking in terms of UI first, forgetting the data", what does "in terms of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in terms of /ɪn ˈtɜːmz əv/ (cụm từ): xét về, theo góc độ. "Think in terms of UI" = suy nghĩ theo góc độ giao diện.
items.explanationEn: in terms of /ɪn ˈtɜːmz əv/ (phrase): from the viewpoint of. "Think in terms of UI" means viewing everything as screens.

items.question: Trong câu "Trap 3: Forgetting authorization", từ "authorization" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trap 3: Forgetting authorization", what does "authorization" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: deciding what a user may do
items.explanation: authorization /ˌɔːθəraɪˈzeɪʃn/ (danh từ): phân quyền truy cập. "Authorization" = ai được làm gì; động từ: authorize.
items.explanationEn: authorization /ˌɔːθəraɪˈzeɪʃn/ (noun): deciding what a user may do. "Authorization" decides who may do what; verb: authorize.

items.question: Trong câu "Trap 4: Not thinking about history / audit trail", từ "audit trail" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trap 4: Not thinking about history / audit trail", what does "audit trail" (phrase) mean?
options: lịch sử thao tác để kiểm tra
optionsEn: a record of who changed what
items.explanation: audit trail /ˈɔːdɪt treɪl/ (cụm từ): lịch sử thao tác để kiểm tra. "Audit trail" = nhật ký ghi lại ai thay đổi gì, lúc nào.
items.explanationEn: audit trail /ˈɔːdɪt treɪl/ (phrase): a record of who changed what. An "audit trail" records who changed what and when.

items.question: Trong câu "Trap 5: Thinking linearly, forgetting concurrent operations", từ "linearly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trap 5: Thinking linearly, forgetting concurrent operations", what does "linearly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: linearly /ˈlɪniəli/ (trạng từ): theo đường thẳng, tuần tự. "Think linearly" = nghĩ tuần tự từng bước; tính từ: linear.
items.explanationEn: linearly /ˈlɪniəli/ (adverb): in a straight sequence. "Think linearly" means one step after another; adjective: linear.

items.question: Trong câu "Trap 5: Thinking linearly, forgetting concurrent operations", từ "concurrent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trap 5: Thinking linearly, forgetting concurrent operations", what does "concurrent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concurrent /kənˈkʌrənt/ (tính từ): đồng thời, cùng lúc. "Concurrent operations" = thao tác đồng thời; danh từ: concurrency.
items.explanationEn: concurrent /kənˈkʌrənt/ (adjective): happening at the same time. "Concurrent operations" happen at the same time; noun: concurrency.

items.question: Trong câu "Trap 5: Thinking linearly, forgetting concurrent operations", từ "operation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trap 5: Thinking linearly, forgetting concurrent operations", what does "operation" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an action a system carries out
items.explanation: operation /ˌɒpəˈreɪʃn/ (danh từ): thao tác xử lý. "Database operation" = thao tác trên database như đọc, ghi.
items.explanationEn: operation /ˌɒpəˈreɪʃn/ (noun): an action a system carries out. A "database operation" is an action such as a read or write.

items.question: Trong câu "Always ask these 3 extra questions after every happy path:", từ "extra" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Always ask these 3 extra questions after every happy path:", what does "extra" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: extra /ˈekstrə/ (tính từ): thêm, bổ sung. "Extra questions" = câu hỏi bổ sung; "extra" (danh từ) còn là diễn viên quần chúng.
items.explanationEn: extra /ˈekstrə/ (adjective): additional. "Extra questions" are additional ones; as a noun an extra is a background actor.

items.question: Trong câu ""What if there's no data?" → empty state", từ "what if" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""What if there's no data?" → empty state", what does "what if" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: what if /ˌwɒt ˈɪf/ (cụm từ): nếu... thì sao. "What if...?" dùng để đặt giả định và tìm edge case.
items.explanationEn: what if /ˌwɒt ˈɪf/ (phrase): what happens in case. "What if...?" asks about a possible situation, perfect for edge cases.

items.question: Trong câu "You don't need complex exercises.", từ "complex" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You don't need complex exercises.", what does "complex" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: complex /ˈkɒmpleks/ (tính từ): phức tạp. "Complex exercises" = bài tập phức tạp; danh từ: complexity.
items.explanationEn: complex /ˈkɒmpleks/ (adjective): complicated. "Complex exercises" are complicated ones; noun: complexity.

items.question: Trong câu "You don't need complex exercises.", từ "exercise" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You don't need complex exercises.", what does "exercise" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: exercise /ˈeksəsaɪz/ (danh từ): bài tập thực hành. "Practice exercises" = bài luyện tập; nghĩa khác: tập thể dục.
items.explanationEn: exercise /ˈeksəsaɪz/ (noun): a practice task. "Practice exercises" are tasks to build skill; it can also mean physical activity.

items.question: Trong câu "What data gets stored? (location, driver, customer, trip, payment)", từ "location" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What data gets stored? (location, driver, customer, trip, payment)", what does "location" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: location /ləʊˈkeɪʃn/ (danh từ): vị trí. "Current location" = vị trí hiện tại; động từ: locate (định vị).
items.explanationEn: location /ləʊˈkeɪʃn/ (noun): a place or position. "Current location" is where you are now; verb: locate.

items.question: Trong câu "What are the screens? (home, confirm booking, tracking, rating)", từ "rating" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What are the screens? (home, confirm booking, tracking, rating)", what does "rating" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rating /ˈreɪtɪŋ/ (danh từ): đánh giá xếp hạng. "Rate the driver" = chấm điểm tài xế; danh từ: rating (điểm đánh giá).
items.explanationEn: rating /ˈreɪtɪŋ/ (noun): a score given by users. "Rate the driver" means give a score; the result is a rating.

items.question: Trong câu "When the driver cancels mid-way → what does the system do?", từ "mid-way" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the driver cancels mid-way → what does the system do?", what does "mid-way" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: in the middle of the process
items.explanation: mid-way /ˌmɪdˈweɪ/ (trạng từ): giữa chừng. "Cancel mid-way" = hủy giữa chừng; thường viết midway.
items.explanationEn: mid-way /ˌmɪdˈweɪ/ (adverb): in the middle of the process. "Cancel mid-way" means stop in the middle; often written midway.

items.question: Trong câu "Why does a ticket have status, priority, assignee, sprint?", từ "priority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why does a ticket have status, priority, assignee, sprint?", what does "priority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: priority /praɪˈɒrəti/ (danh từ): mức độ ưu tiên. "High priority" = ưu tiên cao; động từ: prioritize.
items.explanationEn: priority /praɪˈɒrəti/ (noun): how important something is. "High priority" means very important; verb: prioritize.

items.question: Trong câu "Relationship: Project → Epic → Story → Task is a nested 1-N", từ "nested" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Relationship: Project → Epic → Story → Task is a nested 1-N", what does "nested" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: nested /ˈnestɪd/ (tính từ): lồng nhau. "Nested structure" = cấu trúc lồng nhau; động từ nest = làm tổ, lồng vào.
items.explanationEn: nested /ˈnestɪd/ (adjective): placed one inside another. A "nested structure" puts items inside others; the verb nest also means build a nest.

items.question: Trong câu "Where are comments and attachments stored? (not inside the main ticket)", từ "attachment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Where are comments and attachments stored? (not inside the main ticket)", what does "attachment" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a file added to a message
items.explanation: attachment /əˈtætʃmənt/ (danh từ): tệp đính kèm. "Email attachment" = tệp đính kèm email; động từ: attach.
items.explanationEn: attachment /əˈtætʃmənt/ (noun): a file added to a message. An "email attachment" is a file sent with an email; verb: attach.

items.question: Trong câu "Where are comments and attachments stored? (not inside the main ticket)", từ "main" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Where are comments and attachments stored? (not inside the main ticket)", what does "main" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: main /meɪn/ (tính từ): chính. "The main ticket" = ticket chính; "main flow" = luồng chính.
items.explanationEn: main /meɪn/ (adjective): most important. "The main ticket" is the primary one; "main flow" is the primary flow.

items.question: Trong câu "Which table does this figure come from?", từ "figure" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Which table does this figure come from?", what does "figure" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: figure /ˈfɪɡə/ (danh từ): con số, số liệu. Trong báo cáo, "figure" = con số; "sales figures" = số liệu doanh số.
items.explanationEn: figure /ˈfɪɡə/ (noun): a number in a report. In reports a "figure" is a number; "sales figures" are sales numbers.

items.question: Trong câu "Export to Excel → does the BE query and generate the file, or does the FE do it?", từ "generate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Export to Excel → does the BE query and generate the file, or does the FE do it?", what does "generate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: generate /ˈdʒenəreɪt/ (động từ): tạo ra. "Generate a file" = tạo ra file; danh từ: generation.
items.explanationEn: generate /ˈdʒenəreɪt/ (verb): to produce. "Generate a file" means produce it; noun: generation.

items.question: Trong câu "The most important habit: When you hear a requirement, don't rush to write it down.", từ "habit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most important habit: When you hear a requirement, don't rush to write it down.", what does "habit" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: habit /ˈhæbɪt/ (danh từ): thói quen. "Build a habit" = xây dựng thói quen; đừng nhầm với habitat (môi trường sống).
items.explanationEn: habit /ˈhæbɪt/ (noun): something you do regularly. "Build a habit" means make something regular; do not confuse it with habitat.

items.question: Trong câu "The most important habit: When you hear a requirement, don't rush to write it down.", từ "rush" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most important habit: When you hear a requirement, don't rush to write it down.", what does "rush" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: rush /rʌʃ/ (động từ): vội vàng. "Don't rush to do something" = đừng vội làm gì; "rush hour" = giờ cao điểm.
items.explanationEn: rush /rʌʃ/ (verb): to act too quickly. "Don't rush to do something" means don't hurry; "rush hour" is peak traffic time.

items.question: Trong câu "Use this checklist every time you receive a new feature:", từ "checklist" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use this checklist every time you receive a new feature:", what does "checklist" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a list of items to tick off
items.explanation: checklist /ˈtʃeklɪst/ (danh từ): danh sách kiểm tra. "Go through a checklist" = rà soát danh sách kiểm tra.
items.explanationEn: checklist /ˈtʃeklɪst/ (noun): a list of items to tick off. "Go through a checklist" means check each item in turn.

items.question: Trong câu "Use this checklist every time you receive a new feature:", từ "every time" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use this checklist every time you receive a new feature:", what does "every time" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: every time /ˈevri taɪm/ (cụm từ): mỗi khi, mỗi lần. "Every time you..." = mỗi lần bạn...; tương đương whenever.
items.explanationEn: every time /ˈevri taɪm/ (phrase): whenever. "Every time you..." means whenever you...

items.question: Trong câu "Use this checklist every time you receive a new feature:", từ "receive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use this checklist every time you receive a new feature:", what does "receive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: receive /rɪˈsiːv/ (động từ): nhận được. "Receive a requirement" = nhận yêu cầu; danh từ: receipt (biên lai), receiver.
items.explanationEn: receive /rɪˈsiːv/ (verb): to get something. "Receive a requirement" means get it; nouns: receipt, receiver.
